teaser: Canyon Ranch Austin is open, a new restaurant building is planned on Hwy 71, and live music every weekend.

lead.headline: Canyon Ranch Austin opened its doors on October 15
paragraphs: The 600-acre wellness resort at 600 Moonlight Bend is officially welcoming guests. It has 141 rooms, a 40,000-square-foot spa the company calls the largest in Texas, and 1.5 miles of Lake Travis shoreline on the former Flying X ranch. Rates start at $1,325 a night. A 134-home residential community surrounds the resort.

news.label: Development · Oct 10
news.headline: New restaurant and retail building planned at 5600 Hwy 71
news.body: A state filing shows SpiceQ plans a 10,008-square-foot restaurant and retail building on the Hwy 71 corridor. No tenants announced yet.

news.label: Community
news.headline: The new Spicewood Community Library is under construction
news.body: Work began in January on a 6,000-square-foot library at 1011 Spur 191, built behind the current building so it stays open. State records list completion around January 2027. The Friends group is still fundraising.

news.label: Drinks
news.headline: Bella Loma Distillery's tasting room is pouring agave spirits
news.body: The family-owned distillery serves house-made blanco and reposado in margaritas and Mexican martinis, with añejo, mezcal and whiskey planned.
